subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the preceding Matrix QA stack PR is accepted, should the exact current head be authorized to remove the temporary `qa-matrix` workspace package, lockfile importer, and intermediate QA runtime facade?
rationale: Repository policy intentionally blocks dependency-graph changes until an authorized human confirms the package removal and compatibility boundary; code review cannot grant that authorization.

options.title: Authorize the cleanup
options.body: Confirm the intermediate facade is unshipped and unused, authorize this exact head, and land it after the preceding stack PR.

options.title: Retain temporary compatibility
options.body: Pause the cleanup and preserve a documented compatibility surface if another branch or consumer still depends on the temporary package or direct runtime methods.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this PR until the preceding workflow migration and final ownership direction are reconsidered together.

recommendation.title: Authorize the cleanup
recommendation.body: Confirm the intermediate facade is unshipped and unused, authorize this exact head, and land it after the preceding stack PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision needs repository-level package/dependency authorization and cross-stack ownership judgment; this is the strongest available owner signal among the related history.
